  • Constructor Details

    • Step

      public Step(double durationSeconds, double[] producedMoles, double[] injectedMoles, double pressureBara, double sigmaBara, boolean holdout)
      Freezes one complete measured interval, using the history's named component order.
      Parameters:
      durationSeconds - positive interval duration in seconds
      producedMoles - nonnegative produced amounts, mol per component per interval
      injectedMoles - nonnegative injected amounts, mol per component per interval
      pressureBara - measured average end pressure in bara, or NaN for prediction only
      sigmaBara - positive one-sigma pressure error in bara, or NaN for prediction only
      holdout - true to exclude this pressure from volume fitting
